pages.text: Hope is the light that guides you through life's darkest moments. It's easy to lose hope when things don't go as planned, but remember, even in the hardest times, hope is still there. It is not the absence of hardship but the belief that something better lies ahead. Hold on to hope, − because it's what fuels resilience and keeps you moving forward. The future is a always full of possibilities, and hope gives you the strength to pursue them.
